run_train_stpp: run the spatiotemporal point process training script with argparse flags for model, data, and hyperparameters
run_validate: validate a spatiotemporal model on a test loader and return spatial and temporal log-likelihood metrics
run_learning_rate_schedule: compute the learning rate at a given global step using warmup and cosine decay schedule
run_get_t0_t1: get the start and end time tensors for a named dataset like earthquakes_jp or citibike
run_setup_ddp: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group with NCCL backend for multi-GPU training
